usage: The word '姊妹' refers to sisters, usually meaning female siblings who share the same parents.
It is used to talk about your biological sisters or close female friends who are like sisters to you.
'姊妹' is a plural noun, so it generally refers to more than one sister.
You can use '姊妹' to describe the relationship or to talk about your sisters in general.
It is a respectful and common term used in everyday conversations when discussing family.
